recipes.name: Grilled Paneer Tikka Salad
recipes.description: Charred marinated low-fat cottage cheese tossed with crisp greens, cucumber, and roasted cumin-mint dressing.
instructions: Whisk hung curd, mustard oil, tandoori masala, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, and salt in a bowl.
Coat paneer cubes, diced bell peppers, and onions gently; rest for 15 minutes.
Sear on a hot non-stick tawa or air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until charred at edges.
Serve over crisp cucumber-lettuce greens with fresh mint-coriander chutney and lemon juice.
recipes.oilGheeNotes: Uses only 1 tsp (5g) mustard oil instead of restaurant cream/butter, saving ~180 kcal.

recipes.name: High-Protein Soya Chunk Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced protein-rich soya chunks, mint, and caramelized onions.
instructions: Boil soya chunks in salted water for 5 minutes, drain, and squeeze out excess water.
Marinate chunks with curd, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, and chopped mint.
Sauté sliced onions in 1 tsp ghee until golden, add marinated soya and cook 5 minutes.
Layer 80%-cooked basmati rice on top, cover tightly, and steam on low heat for 8 minutes.
recipes.oilGheeNotes: Measured 1 tsp ghee gives authentic aroma with only 45 kcal from added fat.

recipes.name: Paneer-Stuffed Moong Dal Chilla (2 pcs)
recipes.description: Crispy savory green-yellow moong lentil crepes stuffed with spiced grated paneer and herbs.
instructions: Blend soaked moong dal with ginger, green chilli, and a splash of water into a smooth batter.
Spread ladleful onto a warm non-stick tawa; drizzle 1/2 tsp oil around edges.
Add grated paneer mixed with chaat masala and coriander on one half, fold, and serve with mint chutney.
recipes.oilGheeNotes: Non-stick tawa keeps oil under 1.5 tsp for two full chillas.

recipes.name: High-Protein Gujarati Homemade Thali
recipes.description: Balanced Gujarati meal: 2 Methi Thepla, Gujarati Dal, 100g Paneer Bhurji, Kachumber & Masala Chaas.
instructions: Prepare paneer bhurji with onion, tomato, turmeric, cumin, and 1 tsp oil.
Warm 2 homemade methi theplas on a dry tawa.
Serve alongside a bowl of Gujarati dal, fresh kachumber salad, and chilled masala chaas.
recipes.oilGheeNotes: Replaces extra ghee on thepla with protein-rich paneer bhurji and probiotic chaas.

exercises.name: Barbell / Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Keep shoulder blades tucked, lower under control to mid-chest, press up smoothly.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30°. Focus on upper chest stretch and controlled lockout.

exercises.name: Cable / Machine Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Slight bend in elbows, squeeze chest at center.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull bar to upper chest by driving elbows down, avoid swinging torso.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Keep spine neutral, pull dumbbell toward hip pocket.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the end of each rep.

exercises.name: Rope Face Pulls
exercises.instructions: Pull toward forehead with elbows high for posture and rear delts.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Brace core, press overhead without arching lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.instructions: Lead with elbows up to shoulder height, slow 2-second lowering.

exercises.name: Goblet / Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Keep chest proud, sit between hips, drive through mid-foot.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Place feet shoulder-width, lower to 90° knee bend without lifting lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Push hips back with soft knees until you feel a hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Seated / Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Controlled curl for hamstrings, pause briefly at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.instructions: Full stretch at bottom, pause 1 second at top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows pinned at sides, avoid momentum.

exercises.name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Lock elbows at sides and spread rope at the bottom.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.instructions: Brace abs and glutes, keep a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Hanging / Lying Leg Raises
exercises.instructions: Lift legs with controlled lower-ab contraction, avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.instructions: 8–10% incline at brisk 4.8–5.5 km/h pace — joint-friendly fat loss.

exercises.name: Stationary Cycling
exercises.instructions: Moderate steady resistance for 20–30 minutes.
